importantFindings.title: Signing in on a phone that still holds an erased course brings the erased minors' data back to the server, with no question asked
importantFindings.evidence: src/persistence/syncMode.ts switchToSyncedTables now writes serverErasures(id, 0, 1) for every course the device brings in. settleServerErasures then deletes the server's erased_courses record for that id before the upload. On a local-mode phone, startBackup asks before switching only when the account holds another course; after an erase the account holds none. Example: the owner's second phone has the course from a 0.4.0 course file. The course is erased on the first phone. Later, signing in on the second phone re-uploads the whole course and its students. Nothing tells the user the course was erased and is about to come back. The repository's own fake test 'signing in with a course whose id was erased elsewhere uploads it, accepted again' shows the tombstone lifted before the POST and the student on the server. Decision 19 (agent-taken, 'taken, B6') was edited to accept this. The choice is not informed: the person signing in sees no mention of the erase. The local-mode branch already reads `courses`, so it could read erased_courses and ask, as B5's replace-course question does. Not a blocker: decision 19 documents it, the tombstone migration is not yet installed, and no real rosters are online. Owner confirmation of decision 19, or a confirmation step, is due before real rosters go online.
importantFindings.reproduction: tests/e2e/b6-erase.spec.ts:475 (passes): erased_courses holds the course id, sign-in, then the order is 'DELETE erased_courses' before 'POST courses', and the course and its student are on the fake server.

qolFindings.title: A lift that failed at the switch stays pending and can later undo an erase made on another phone
qolFindings.evidence: keepForLater keeps erase = 0, keep = 1 after a failed lift. If the owner erases the course on another phone before this phone's next connection, that connection lifts the new tombstone and uploads the course again. The window is narrow: only between the failed lift and the next connection.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading of session.ts settleServerErasures (keep list, lifted=false path) and serverErasures.ts keepForLater.

qolFindings.title: A privacy test failed once in a full run
qolFindings.evidence: tests/e2e/b4-uploads.spec.ts:430 'a refusal arriving after the course was erased is not kept' failed once in a combined run of b6-erase, b6-erase-live and b4-uploads at ab995d2. It then passed alone twice and in a full b4-uploads run. The failure output was overwritten before I could read it, so whether the privacy assertion or the toPass timing failed is unknown. File it as a flaky test (H1).

evidenceInspected: git diff 822cb50..ab995d2 -- src supabase tests: session.ts (lift no longer blocks the connection, keepForLater), serverErasures.ts, migrations.ts (courseLeftThisDevice keeps a course-row refusal that has a keep record; compaction at open), syncMode.ts (keep = 1 at the switch), CourseErase.tsx (other-account wording), the b4 and b6 fake specs

Abuse angles. Another account: erased_courses RLS limits the lift to the caller's own ownerId, and an other-account device returns before the settle, so it cannot lift account A's tombstone. A stale synced phone: it has no keep record, so its course-row upsert gets CVERA, the refusal ('erased') counts as left, and its refusals are dropped and the database compacted. A crafted local keep record needs devtools on a device that already holds the data. The switch path (SP-B6-R3-1) is the real one.

Personal data kept: refusals of a course whose lift is pending stay in uploadRefusals for Riprova. That is the device's own current course, listed and discardable, and an erase on this device sets keep = 0.
Ran b6-erase (10), b6-erase-live (3, CVERA branch skipped) and b4-uploads (9) on pixel-7-chrome, port 4235: one flaky failure (Q2), then green; vitest src/persistence: 421 passed, 1 expected fail
Development account 1 empty afterwards (courses 0, students 0); working tree clean

lenses: Round 3, restricted: keep = 1 at the switch and the lift (another account, stale local phone, stale synced phone, crafted record), the removal of erase = 2, courseLeftThisDevice with keep records, and regressions in b4 and b6
